alt: Green and gold ELVES Mori gravel bike with Shimano GRX, drive side, in a bike shop, with MORI AEROX on the chainstay
display_note: Shop-built bike from a July 2025 post; its chainstay reads MORI AEROX, but this lead's Mori subtrim is unconfirmed. Edges cropped to remove QR codes.

review_evidence.conclusion: Original pixels reviewed: ELVES on the down tube, MORI on the fork and MORI AEROX on the chainstay of a shop-built gravel bike. The lead's own sources do not name its subtrim, so this photo shows the Mori family without confirming the lead's subtrim. Top and bottom strips were cropped to remove payment QR codes, a partial person, a partial shop sign and a faint corner stamp; no bike pixels were removed.
